Cost-aware public evidence now plans fresh cache -> DNS/official public sources -> static HTTP -> browser only after observed static-HTTP insufficiency -> licensed API -> model inference, stopping when sufficient evidence is reached.

Public-evidence cache entries are provenance/hash/expiry bound and public extraction remains subject to current source-policy, robots, terms/purpose and public-source gates; private/credentialed/CAPTCHA-bypass/personal-data inference remains prohibited.

Asynchronous staged content now has a Postgres repository with source evidence, policy/version refs, payload hashes, expiry and concurrent FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED claiming; staged content grants no send or publication authority.

Programmatic fulfillment now compiles idempotent provisioning plans only after canonical cleared-payment evidence and requires provider receipts for provisioning truth; uncertain effects block blind retry.

Programmatic fulfillment prohibits raw long-lived credential/token delivery and unexpected raw token/secret fields. Customer access should use provider invite, expiring magic link or one-time claim mechanisms.

Economic feedback allocation now proposes bounded business-profile weights using paid-and-accepted outcomes, cleared contribution and founder minutes, with minimum evidence thresholds, shrinkage, exploration floor, max per-cycle deltas and optimistic concurrency.
Economic allocation rejects sensitive personal targeting dimension keys while allowing legitimate business dimensions such as industry=healthcare; it never changes code, policy or external authority.
